_comment: PRESET: digital design/pattern downloads. Price bands are USD, from docs/research-findings-2026-11-23.md (live-listing bands, directional). Pricing block: digital has NO production or shipping cost — the calculator runs with zeros; the only per-sale costs are Etsy's fees. Listing fee in the pricing defaults is US$0.20.

creation_path: Stage 3 research names the niche community and the bundle shape buyers already pay for
Write the design brief: your motifs, your lettering, your style — franchise bundles in search results are infringement stock, not inspiration
Produce the original files to spec: clean vector paths, exported as SVG + PNG + DXF inside one ZIP; every file <=20 MB, max 5 files per listing
Price with pipeline/pricing.py at zero production cost; singles build reviews, bundles carry the margin (Stage 5)
Generate the listing pack with pipeline/listing.py (Stage 6), licence terms stated, publish gate (Stage 7), then test-download your own files
delivery: Instant download — Etsy delivers the files at checkout; no shipping, no fulfilment, no Printify (skip Stage 2 and the Printify half of Stage 5)
launch_checklist: Stage 1: intake answered — existing shop health-checked (Etsy Payments active, bank verified, shop policies set, production partners disclosed); no shop yet → appendix walkthrough first (docs/appendix-shop-creation.md)
Stage 2: SKIPPED — no Printify for downloads; note it and move on
Stage 3: niche scored with pipeline/scoring.py; confirm the designs are yours (Etsy requires digital items be made/designed by the seller)
Stage 4: files exported clean; SVG/PNG/DXF packed in a ZIP; every file <=20 MB; max 5 files per listing; filenames <=70 chars (buyers see them)
Stage 5: price with the calculator at zero product/shipping cost; check the fee-only margin at your band's low end too
Stage 6: listing pack generated; description states INSTANT DOWNLOAD, no physical item, file formats, and your licence terms (personal vs commercial use); AI disclosure if AI assisted
Stage 7: human approves the exact files + pack; publish as a Digital listing; read the live listing back and test-download your own files
Stage 8: no fulfilment to watch — watch download problems, licence questions, and reviews instead; weekly review as written

summary: Your own SVG cut files, patterns, printables and template packs, sold as instant downloads. Research verdict (2026-11-23): singles are the cheapest product on Etsy ($2-8) — bundles carry the business (10-design $15-25, mega bundles $25-45). Files must be made/designed by you; .svg is NOT an accepted direct upload format, so SVGs ship inside a ZIP (max 5 files per listing, 20 MB each, no variations on digital listings).
